fold_rule: Each test interval is evaluated from a clean strategy instance with only authorized earlier replay history. Pivot-02 is a no-fit deterministic rule; every fold artifact still binds exact source/config/seed, cutoff, three-day embargo, A5 manifest, and clean-process declaration. No full-period scaler, selector, coefficient, or ensemble is carried into a fold.
future_required_bindings: six byte-distinct model/declaration artifact SHA-256 values
six fold return artifact SHA-256 values
exact source bundle, strategy, frozen config, no-control risk policy, seed, A5 manifest, and journal-head hashes
central fold, quarter, regime, role, sleeve, stability, concentration, requested-gross, and insolvency evidence
purge_and_embargo: The strategy is unsupervised, but the declared A5 forward label spans 72 hours. Purge every score/label pair whose forward endpoint crosses a fold boundary and reserve the final three calendar days before each test start as embargo.
selection_rule: No fold is optional and no failed or insolvent fold is discarded. Stitched chronological evidence can qualify only when all frozen gates pass. Negative or unqualified evidence is recorded and pivot-02 terminates as DNF rather than being submitted.
